Name: Abigail Portrait Overhaul (CP)
Author: yuninocorn
Description:
[b][size=4]General[/size][/b]
This content pack changes Abigail's portrait seasonally.
Her spring and winter outfits are edits of her vanilla ones, making her hairstyle a little more alt and slightly changing her overall appearance, but still keeping it close to the vanilla style.
I have also added simple outfits for summer, fall and the ginger island resort.

[size=4][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]
This content pack can be used alongside Seasonal Cute Characters. If you disable Abigail within that mod's config options, this mod's portraits/sprites will be used for all occasions. If you don't, Seasonal Cute Characters' festival portraits will still apply, as this mod does not change her festival outfits.

Enjoy!
